label: ASC AI v2 — Full-frame mixed-view ensemble (PyTorch ResNet18)
summary: Validation-selected 25% cropped + 75% full-frame ensemble. Full-frame model resizes the complete 16:9 image to 384x216 without cropping. Expanded 269-frame benchmark: 96.7% gate accuracy, 96.6% rain F1, 7 false-OK, 2 false-NO-GO.
notes: Inference blends cloudy and rain probabilities at 25% center-crop / 75% full-frame before applying 0.5 thresholds. Member checksums and benchmark provenance are in ASC_AI_v2/MANIFEST.json.
